bullets.text: defrosting the freezer with a hair dryer and a spatula. a pea from last winter surfaced, fully intact.
🌫️ clear and cold at okunoin. the duck carries a line about cheer under all circumstances. frost on a stone lantern, sunny side dripping.
the smoke alarm chirped once at 3am, then went quiet. just wanted me to know it could.
wednesday has the posture of a folding chair. holds the weight, would rather not.
